info.title: API-DocTest-List Telecom Sim Esim Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM eSIM Status API provides real-time access to the status information of eSIMs associated with telecom services. This API allows developers to retrieve critical details about the operational state of eSIMs, including activation status and readiness for use. Typical consumers of this API include telecom operators and application developers integrating eSIM management into their platforms. By using this API, businesses can enhance customer experience through timely and accurate eSIM status updates.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of the eSIM.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of the embedded SIM (eSIM) for a specified device. It provides information regarding connectivity and provisioning state.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to query the current status of the eSIM. Ensure that all required parameters are provided to receive accurate status information.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the current eSIM status is returned.

ListTelecomSimEsimStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to the status of the SIM card in the eSIM service.
